name: What are the benefits of building a multigenerational living suite?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of building a multigenerational living suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multigenerational living suites offer several benefits, including enhanced family support, shared childcare or elder care responsibilities, and potential cost savings on housing. They can also provide a steady rental income if used as an ADU for non-family members. When considering this option, homeowners should assess their family's long-term needs and how the suite can adapt to changing circumstances over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include family support, shared care responsibilities, potential cost savings, and rental income.
